summary: The new mini games and the rest of the suite pass (21 of 23), but two regression tests still fail: the side panel again shows developer text (journal/todo prose with 'testing', 'real browser', 'Queued for the break'), and a creature sent to the pier does not stay fishing.

failures.what: The side panel shows developer talk to the player
failures.steps: Open the dashboard and read the right-hand panel ('Last built' and 'Next on the list')
failures.expected: Only player-facing text about the island and its features
failures.actual: 'Last built: Queued for the break' is followed by the author's journal prose ('I played Firefly catch from a real browser the way you do... ') and a todo list headed '○ testing'

failures.what: A creature assigned to fish on the pier drops the fishing goal before it arrives
failures.steps: Run the test 'A creature walks out on the pier and fishes': give a non-controlled creature the :fish goal, put it at the root of the pier, wait 18 s
failures.expected: The creature reaches the end of the pier and is fishing (goal :fish, arrived)
failures.actual: Gloop was at (2.3, 14.3, 1.4) with goal :play, so the fishing goal was replaced by another goal before it arrived
